items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。

items.source: Entry point for creating executable find operations.
items.translation: 创建可执行查找操作的入口点。

items.source: Terminating operations invoking the actual query execution.
items.translation: 终止调用实际查询执行的操作。

items.source: Triggers find execution by calling one of the terminating methods.
items.translation: 触发器通过调用终止方法之一来执行。
